scope: Original joint168 C8 last attention from HcPre to next FFN HcPre. Fixed original schedule, same cache/input AG costs and all-live DP ineligible for local row removal.
limits: The inclusive scope credits host/device gaps and other recorded time as free, preserves original cache and input AG occupancy, and serially propagates the largest favorable DP credit per wave.
No credit is assigned for changing attention's earliest producer or cache policy, for FFN/expert work, or for changed cross-DP arrivals.
All-live DP retains its work. Peer waits may move as part of a wider EP16 schedule and must be priced there.
Row-order envelope is independent of dictionary ordering. It is not an observation of live logits_indices, cache table contents or native numerical equivalence.
